---
title: "ocel env"
description: "Manage this project's variable values."
---

```bash
ocel env <command>
```

<include>../../../cli/env.mdx</include>

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`ocel env get`](/docs/cli/env/get) | Inspect a value |
| [`ocel env history`](/docs/cli/env/history) | List a value's history |
| [`ocel env ls`](/docs/cli/env/ls) | List values without revealing them |
| [`ocel env ref`](/docs/cli/env/ref) | Read a value stored elsewhere |
| [`ocel env refs`](/docs/cli/env/refs) | List references to a value |
| [`ocel env rm`](/docs/cli/env/rm) | Remove a value |
| [`ocel env set`](/docs/cli/env/set) | Set a value |
| [`ocel env source`](/docs/cli/env/source) | Show where a tier's values are read from, and how its last sync went |
| [`ocel env sync`](/docs/cli/env/sync) | Read the env source a tier's last deploy registered into its values now |
| [`ocel env ui`](/docs/cli/env/ui) | Open the variable editor |
